title: GenomeMetabolismCapabilities
description: Schema for high-level microbial bioenergetics and metabolic capability profile in genome_metabolism_capabilities.json

ATP_synthesis.description: ATP synthase types and respiratory complexes (V/A-type, F-type, Complex I, II, bc1, oxidases)

methanogenesis.description: Methanogenesis pathways (CO2, methanol, methylamine, acetate), methanotrophy, and cofactor biosynthesis (CoM, F420, F430, methanofuran)

nitrogen_metabolism.description: Nitrogen transformations (nitrogen fixation, nitrification/amo, comammox, DNRA, assimilatory nitrate reduction, denitrification, anammox)

sulfur_metabolism.description: Sulfur oxidation and dissimilatory/assimilatory reduction pathways (DSR, Sox, sulfide oxidation, sulfur reduction, S4I)

carbon_fixation.description: Autotrophic carbon fixation pathways (Wood-Ljungdahl, 3-HP/4-HB, DC/4-HB, rTCA, 3-HP bi-cycle, Calvin cycle, acetyl-CoA to acetate)

fermentation_and_central_carbon.description: Fermentation, pyruvate oxidation, and archaeal modified central carbohydrate pathways (archaeal PPP, semi/non-phosphorylative ED, pentose bisphosphate)
